map.Base32 为何比 Base64 长？: Why is Base32 longer than Base64?
map.Base32 以 = 填充至 8 字符倍数，长度估算已含填充。: Base32 pads with = to a multiple of 8 characters, and the length estimate already includes padding.
map.Base32 每 5 字节编码为 8 个字符含填充时长度恒为 8 的倍数: Base32 encodes every 5 bytes into 8 characters, so with padding the length is always a multiple of 8
map.Base32 每位仅携 5 bit（Base64 携 6 bit），同样数据需更: Each Base32 character carries only 5 bits (Base64 carries 6), so the same data needs more characters, roughly 60% expansion.

map.与 Base64 比较：Base32 膨胀更大但字符集更安全，用于免混淆显示。: Compared with Base64, Base32 expands more but its character set is safer for confusion-free display.
map.二维码/短链容量评估：Base32 无小写与易混字符，适合人工抄写场景的长度预算: QR code and short link capacity planning: Base32 has no lowercase and no ambiguous characters, so it suits length budgets for manually transcribed text.
map.人工抄写、语音核对等需避免 0/O、1/l 混淆的场合。: Situations needing manual transcription or voice verification where 0/O and 1/l confusion must be avoided.
map.密钥/令牌长度预估：TOTP 密钥、随机令牌经 Base32 约膨胀 1.6×，: Key and token length planning: TOTP secrets and random tokens expand about 1.6x through Base32, so size storage fields accordingly.
